statement:
The layout record gives column 1 as empty for this case, but it conflicts with the confirmed physical layout identifying column 1 as irreplaceable samples and column 7 as empty.
Lysis buffer was added to column 7 of plate P-4, preserving the irreplaceable samples in column 1.
judge_text:
